name: Create a cohesive laboratory of expressive UI microinteractions
prompt: Create the interaction laboratory described in CREATIVE_BRIEF.md. Deliver a single polished responsive page containing at least six related microinteractions across navigation, controls, feedback, state change, and direct manipulation. Establish one coherent motion language, support keyboard and reduced-motion use, and document the principles in MOTION_SYSTEM.md. Use native JavaScript or a documented animation framework. Human reviewers will judge delight, coherence, restraint, and craft; there is no code-computed creativity score.
